correctness.rationale: The bracket recursion makes the first column determine the automorphism; any column with first entry a≠0 gives a triangular map with diagonal a,a²,…,aⁿ and preserves all zero brackets. On k[t]/(tⁿ) this map is aU(t)σ_a. In the conjugacy equation U(t)W(at)=H(t^ℓ)W(t), the degree-j coefficient of the new gauge term is aʲ−1, so a choice can be made at every degree, with only multiples of ℓ retained in H. The cyclic norm is conjugacy invariant and equals H^ℓ; raising to ℓ is bijective on the abelian principal-unit p-group, giving uniqueness. The centralizing gauges are the units supported at multiples of ℓ, so all normal forms have the stated equal-size fibers. Only the exponent residue ℓ−1 can support fixed vectors. With m=⌊n/ℓ⌋ this block is multiplication by H−1 on k[z]/(z^m), giving dimension min(m,ord(H−1)) or zero for m=0. Uniform coefficients of H give the displayed multiplicities; ℓ=1 and m=1 obey the same count, and the ℓ>n case gives the fixed-point-free criterion by cyclicity of k×. Burnside accounts for ordered tuples and the one-tuple count follows also by making the leading coordinate an i-th power orbit and removing all higher coefficients by principal units. Fresh exhaustive elimination for (q,n)=(2,4),(3,4),(5,5),(7,4) agreed with all histograms, including a fixed-point-free sector, and an explicit nonconstant ℓ=2 conjugacy over F₅ preserved the computed fixed rank.
residual_risks: Fresh computation is confined to small prime-field cases. The proof covers extension fields and unbounded n.
Conjugacy at fixed a is under the principal-unit subgroup, not the full group.

originality.rationale: The all-automorphism fixed-space polynomial in the natural n-dimensional representation is the supported distinct claim. The triangular parametrization and group structure are established. The strongest same-family catalogue comparator contains the same norm-based normal form and equal fibers, and another gives the one-tuple orbit count; neither is credited here as an independent originality gain. The same-family element-order and abstract conjugacy counts do not count the individual fixed-block ranks, which require resolving the full first nonzero resonant coefficient rather than just thresholds for its p-power order.
residual_risks: Group-theoretic normalization is classical and precisely overlaps a distinct archive source. Displayed archive dates do not establish authorship or priority.
The cited Normurodovna DOI 10.55640/eijmrms-06-06-16 was not available in full text through the bounded retrieval; exact coverage by that paper remains unverified.
No exhaustive literature-priority conclusion follows from the bounded comparisons.

value.rationale: The fixed-space polynomial is a natural invariant of the actual automorphism action, rather than an abstract group order. It distinguishes nonsemisimple operators within a scalar order, gives exact probabilities of each fixed dimension, and by Burnside supplies all tuple-orbit counts rather than merely the one-vector marginal. Those uses justify the precise census even after crediting the known normalization.
residual_risks: The uses established here concern only the natural null-filiform module and its ordered tuples.
